units.source_text: 八月的一天下午，一个男人把大木箱和水壶交叉地背在肩上，把裤脚塞在袜子里，像去登山似的。

en.t: One afternoon in August, a man carried a large wooden box and a water bottle slung crosswise over his shoulders, tucked the cuffs of his trousers into his socks, and looked as if he were going mountain climbing.

units.source_text: 他戴了一顶灰色的太阳帽，在S车站下了车，站在月台上。

en.t: He was wearing a gray sun hat, and after getting off the train at S Station, he stood on the platform.
